usedFor: LiveChat holds the conversations, and Asana receives a task through “Create Task or Subtask” after a “Finished Chat”.

bestTemplate.name: “Finished Chat” in LiveChat, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A finished chat is complete, so the task can capture the follow-up with an assignee and date.

watchOut: “Chat Changed” fires when a chat's tag list changes, so it can create several tasks for one chat.
